Radiology reports describing medical findings and impressions
Generated radiology reports (text) describing findings and impressions

changes_made.explanation: Removed module names from models list as modules are components of MedWriter model itself. Simplified outputs description.
Simplified metric variants to base forms (BLEU-1/2/3/4 → BLEU, ROUGE-L → ROUGE) as per guidelines
BERT is used for representation learning in MedWriter, not as a judge for evaluation. Report classification is for medical diagnosis, not NLG evaluation.

guideline: Radiologists rated each report on realism and relevance using a 1-5 Likert scale
- Radiologists rated each report on a scale of 1 to 5 for realistic and relevant.

Two experienced radiologists were asked to give ratings for each selected report, in terms of whether the generated reports are realistic and relevant to the X-ray images. The ratings are integers from one to five. The higher, the better.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant guideline descriptions into a single clear statement

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper evaluates medical report generation using automatic metrics and human evaluation by radiologists. No LLMs were used as judges - BERT was used as part of the model architecture only.
